internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Our campus feels like a small academic village, with everything within walking distance. Classes take place in three distinct buildings; Franklin, Eleanor, and Anne, each named after the Roosevelts and each with a character of its own.

Eleanor is the academic heart of UCR. This is where you’ll attend most of your classes and where you’ll find all faculty offices, close and approachable. It’s also home to our well-being space, with areas for yoga, meditation, or even a quick nap in a sleeping pod. Because learning thrives when you feel your best.

Anne is our most modern building. Purpose-built for today’s students, it features labs, flexible classrooms, open study spaces, and its own quiet garden. Whether you’re working on a group project or researching in a lab, Anne supports innovative learning in a calm and inspiring setting.
